title: Bacteriophage T4 gene 32 protein: Insights into its Interaction with ssDNA, binding cooperativity, and conformational change
authors: Jules Guei; Michael P. Chapman; Paul N. Brothers; Shital Desai; Richard L. Karpel
one_liner_zh: 该文研究T4噬菌体gp32蛋白与ssDNA的结合及协同性，涉及构象变化和蛋白-DNA互作机制，但对象为单链DNA结合蛋白而非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模。
abstract: The single-stranded DNA binding protein of bacteriophage T4, gp32, has important roles in replication, recombination, and repair. gp32 possesses three domains: the central (core) domain which contains the binding trough for single-stranded DNA, the N-terminal domain, which interacts with the core domain of an adjacent ssDNA-bound protein, bringing about binding cooperativity, and the C-terminal domain, which interacts with other proteins involved in replication, recombination, and repair. The essential residues within the N-domain for the association with the adjacent DNA bound gp32, Lys-Arg-Lys-Ser-Thr, the “LAST Motif” , is almost identical to the ssDNA-interactive residues within the core domain binding trough, and was the basis of a model in which a “closed” ⇄ “open” conformational change within core domain controls DNA binding. In this study, we show that alteration of the core domain LAST sequence , while maintaining its composition , can have an effect on the binding parameters, and may be the result of a shift in the closed-open equilibrium. Additionally, utilizing a gp32 truncated at residue 227, as well as amino acid substituted variants, we have further localized the residues within the core domain responsible for the protein-protein association leading to cooperative ssDNA binding. Truncation leads to an increase in the non-cooperative affinity for single-stranded nucleic acids, which can be explained by the absence of a closed conformation in this variant. The truncated protein forms a tight complex with core domain on a 12-residue oligonucleotide, a potential candidate for further structural study.
abstract_zh: T4噬菌体的单链DNA结合蛋白gp32在复制、重组和修复中具有重要作用。gp32包含三个结构域：中央（核心）结构域，含有单链DNA结合槽；N端结构域，与相邻ssDNA结合蛋白的核心结构域相互作用，从而实现结合协同性；以及C端结构域，与参与复制、重组和修复的其他蛋白质相互作用。N结构域中与相邻DNA结合gp32关联的关键残基，Lys-Arg-Lys-Ser-Thr，即“LAST基序”，与核心结构域结合槽内的ssDNA相互作用残基几乎相同，这构成了一个模型的基础，该模型认为核心结构域内的“闭合”⇄“开放”构象变化控制着DNA结合。在本研究中，我们表明，在保持其组成不变的情况下，改变核心结构域LAST序列可能对结合参数产生影响，这可能是闭合-开放平衡移动的结果。此外，利用在残基227处截短的gp32以及氨基酸取代变体，我们进一步定位了核心结构域内负责蛋白质-蛋白质关联从而促进协同ssDNA结合的残基。截短导致对单链核酸的非协同亲和力增加，这可以通过该变体中缺乏闭合构象来解释。截短蛋白与核心结构域在12残基寡核苷酸上形成紧密复合物，这是进一步结构研究的潜在候选对象。
